subject: SIG: KMS rotation attestation & rotation log samples
messages:
From: Laura Winters <laura.winters@crestbank.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Adam Price <adam.price@crestbank.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T08:04:00-07:00
Subject: SIG: Request for KMS rotation attestation and rotation logs

Hi Karthik,

We're preparing a SIG/CAIQ package for an internal audit and need a compact set of artifacts around your KMS/HSM practices. Can you provide the following by Friday, May 6?

- Signed HSM attestation or vendor proof of tamper-resistance (PDF)
- Rotation logs (wrap/unwrap events) for the last 180 days, redacted to remove tenant identifiers
- Operator custody/role matrix for KMS/HSM access (who performed rotations and approve flows)
- A short note on how you handle in-transit key wrapping (envelope encryption) and how you validate wrapping keys post-rotation

If you prefer, we can accept redacted CSVs and a single attestation PDF. We may want a short 30-minute walkthrough after artifacts are uploaded.

Thanks,
Laura Winters
Sr. Cloud Security Manager, Crestbank
security@crestbank.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Winters <laura.winters@crestbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for KMS rotation attestation and rotation logs

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you requested but want to confirm a couple quick items so we tailor the package: 

1) Rotation window: you asked for 180 days; do you need per-rotation operator usernames or only aggregated counts/stamped events? We can do both but per-operator rows will require a brief redaction pass.
2) HSM attestation: would a vendor-signed PDF (FIPS/HSM provider attestation) plus our internal operator shift log suffice, or do you need any additional third-party test reports?
3) Envelope encryption snippet: we'll include a one-page description and a short sample of wrapping/unwrapping calls from our runtime.

Plan: Marissa will assemble the artifacts and stage redacted CSVs to a secure Drive link; Ben will coordinate timing for the walkthrough. We expect to have the first drop by EOD Thursday, May 2, and the final set by May 6.

If that works, we'll proceed and attach the staged files and attestation.

—Karthik
Principal Product Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Winters <laura.winters@crestbank.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for KMS rotation attestation and rotation logs

Laura — putting together the artifact list below and attaching a compact bundle preview. Notes inline.

Attachments (stubs):
- kms_rotation_manifest.csv (redacted wrap/unwrap events; timestamp, rotation_id, operator_id, algorithm, prior_key_id -> new_key_id)
- hsm_attestation_2027-02.pdf (vendor-signed HSM attestation; tamper proof vendor statement)
- rotation_runbook_excerpt.txt (how we perform scheduled rotations and emergency rewraps)
- operator_acl_snapshot.csv (current operator ACL export; user id, role, last_auth_time)

Inline clarifications:
- Per-operator detail: we can provide per-operator rows with hashed operator IDs for privacy; a separate mapping can be provided under NDA if you need identity resolution.
- Redaction: tenant and request payloads are removed. We include trace IDs for cross-reference only.
- Envelope flow: the runbook excerpt covers transient wrapping keys, KDF used, and how we retire wrapping keys after rotation.

We will upload the first package to a secure Drive folder and send the link in a follow-up email within 24 hours. If you need the attestation notarized, let us know and we'll request the provider's extended report.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Winters <laura.winters@crestbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Adam Price <adam.price@crestbank.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for KMS rotation attestation and rotation logs

Marissa — this looks good. A couple of follow-ups:

- Please include an operator ACL snapshot (CSV) with role names and last-auth timestamps (redacted user IDs are fine).
- Can you add a short summary note (1–2 paragraphs) describing your key compromise recovery process and how you verify rewrapped data post-rotation? That's a common SIG request.

Also, we'll need an NDA signed before we accept the operator identity mapping if you provide it. I've looped in Adam Price, who will run procurement for the NDA. If you can send a DocuSign link or preferred contact for legal, that would speed things up.

Best,
Laura
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Winters <laura.winters@crestbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: Request for KMS rotation attestation and rotation logs

Laura — thanks, we'll add the ACL snapshot and the short compromise/recovery summary. I'm scheduling a 30-minute walkthrough for the week of May 3; proposed slots attached in the Drive link.

Next steps (owner):
- Marissa: stage redacted CSVs + HSM attestation (by 2027-05-02)
- Karthik: prepare 1-paragraph envelope encryption validation note (by 2027-05-02)
- Ben: send DocuSign NDA link to Adam and confirm walkthrough time (by 2027-04-30)

If anything changes, I'll follow up. Looking forward to closing this out quickly.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Sales, Redwood Inference
